125:- [ ] 9.1 TDD the pure module `scripts/legacyBuild/findLegacySyntaxIssues.ts` (design D9, FR13). Input: file name and source. Output: a list of `{ file, construct }`. It parses with `acorn` (`ecmaVersion: 2020`, module), walks the AST and reports parse errors, `ChainExpression`, `??`, BigInt literals and regex lookbehind, both in regex literals and in `new RegExp(…)` / `RegExp(…)` calls whose first argument is a string literal (design D9). `findInsetShorthand(css)` reports `inset:` declarations, and `findDvhWithoutFallback(css)` reports every rule with a `dvh` declaration that has no declaration of the same property with a `vh` value before it in that rule (FR12, design D7, D9). Tests in `src/test/legacyBuild/findLegacySyntaxIssues.test.ts` with `it.each`, header `// FR12, FR13 of support-legacy-ios-12-safari`:
134:- [ ] 9.2 Add `scripts/check-legacy-build.mjs` and the script `"check:legacy-build": "node scripts/check-legacy-build.mjs"` in `packages/client/package.json`. It reads `dist/assets/*.{js,css}`, `dist/sw.js` and `dist/workbox-*.js`, prints every issue and exits non-zero on any. Add a test in `src/test/legacyBuild/checkLegacyBuild.test.ts` that runs the script with `execFileSync` against a temporary fixture directory (as `src/test/benchmarks/benchBudgets.test.ts` does): a fixture with `inset:0` in CSS exits non-zero and names the file; a fixture with `.min-h-dvh{min-height:100dvh}` exits non-zero and names the file (FR12); a clean fixture (including `min-height:100vh;min-height:100dvh`) exits 0. Verify with `npx vitest run src/test/legacyBuild`, then `pnpm run build`, then `pnpm --filter @time-zones/client check:legacy-build` exits 0 with no issues (M2).
135:- [ ] 9.3 Mutation run of the new `scripts/` modules (M6). Stryker's default `mutate` covers only `src/**`, so run it scoped, as the archived change `replace-wall-clock-row-budgets-with-deterministic-checks` did for `scripts/benchBudgets.ts`. The glue modules (`legacyCoreJsPlugin.ts`, `mainChunkPreloadPlugin.ts`, `check-legacy-build.mjs`) are covered by tasks 5.3, 5.6 and 9.2.

153:- [ ] 11.2 Handoff H2: write `handoff/H2-adr-supported-browser-engines.patch` and its README section. The patch adds `docs/adr/0009-supported-browser-engines.md` (status Accepted, format of `.claude/rules/adr.md`, naming `support-legacy-ios-12-safari`) covering the supported engines (latest evergreen and iOS Safari 12.5), the boot-time conditional polyfills, the BigInt ban, and the legacy zone shim as a stopgap under ADR-0003's known limitation. It links the ADR from the ADR list in `CLAUDE.md` and the table in `docs/architecture/overview.md`.
